name: DCA Aunt Cass Café Japanese-Style Curry Beef in a Boudin Sourdough Bread Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: aunt cass curry beef bread bowl
whyItWorks: Slow-simmered tender beef, soft carrots, and diced potatoes in a savory-sweet Japanese curry roux inside a warm Boudin sourdough bowl—much lower in lactose than the clam chowder, though mildly spiced.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with the curry on the side if you want to control how much sauce you dip the warm sourdough bread into, and skip the pickled red ginger garnish.
watchOuts: Contains mild Japanese curry spices and onions simmered in the gravy—save for steady days
